what: Three areas (services · roles) are drawn as three ellipses that swell to 1.52x in turn every 1.15s and return. Size follows a spring (stiffness 8, damping .3), overshooting slightly before settling, and the enlarged ellipse wobbles ±2.5% while its name text grows. A rounded outline around the group, inflated by 50 and shrunk back, breathes along as one extra line. It pauses when off-screen or when the tab is hidden.

options.step: Duration of one ellipse’s swelling turn (s), default 1.15
options.wobble: Wobble strength of the swollen ellipse, default .025
options.hull: Distance the outline swells and shrinks (in 680×420 panel units), default 50

from.where: service.html #md-workflow (workflow.js) — original WorkflowAnimation (stepDuration 1.15 · ramp .5 · stiffness 8 · damping .3 · hero 1.52 · wobble .025 · offsetPx 50, 680×420 panel)

note: The original makes the outline with union and offset from a polygon operation library (clipper, BSL) — it is outside the allowed list, so the same closed shape was rebuilt with two passes of a 4-unit grid distance transform + contour lines. Text uses --kf-font-display, lines use --kf-ink(.8)
